key_points: Contour Asset Management sold all AT&T shares in Q3, signaling institutional skepticism.
Dividend warning signs highlighted for AT&T, with modest dividend coverage raising risk.
No major earnings, guidance, or regulatory developments specific to AT&T in the headlines.
Market attention focused on AI, SpaceX, and other high‑growth themes, leaving AT&T relatively overlooked.
Potential short‑term pressure from dividend concerns and fund selling, but limited upside catalyst.
